Bloomberg: new MacBook Pro will be released in a month and a half and will be thinner

There is  a month and a half  left before the release of the new MacBook Pro, says Mark Gurman from Bloomberg. According to his information, it will not be just another chip update, as the lineup has been limited to for the past five years. He did not specify the exact release date.

The laptops will become  lighter and thinner . Gurman did not specify by how much. They will have  OLED displays with touch input . Along with the change in the display, the notch in the top of the screen will disappear: in its place will be the Dynamic Island with "activity auras" - the term Apple officially uses to refer to Live Activities.

In terms of hardware, the models will receive the same  M5 Pro and M5 Max . Gurman claims that Apple has significantly redesigned the internal layout, so the body will become thinner not only due to the replacement of the IPS display with OLED.

Bloomberg does not provide the new prices. Currently, the 14-inch version with M5 Pro starts at $2500, and the 16-inch at $3000.

Spain exempts self-custody wallets from crypto tax reporting

Spain's tax authorities have confirmed that cryptocurrency held in self-custody wallets — where the owner controls the private keys — does not need to be reported under Form 721, the country's disclosure form for foreign-held digital assets. The exemption hinges on one condition: no third party holds the assets on your behalf.

The rule draws a clean line between personal custody and exchange or custodial holdings abroad, which remain reportable. Simple in principle, potentially significant in practice — Spain just gave self-custody a regulatory edge.
